systemic_findings: Folder paths are useful evidence but are not canonical identity. Embedded SVG document/export names can reveal source-history conflicts.
Two Ninjago assets under Ninjago/Slithra are internally named Skales and match Skales' distinct 98143pb01 head rather than Slithraa's 98143pb02 head.
Historical/source-local labels must remain in provenance while canonical catalog names are stored separately (for example Indian -> Tribal Hunter, Tim -> Timmy, Lex Luther -> Lex Luthor).
Generic numbered/calibration faces are useful style supervision but must not be forced to a physical release.
Game-only characters such as Dr. Clickitt should route to game-reference supervision rather than physical catalog matching.

Subject identity, expression semantics, landmark geometry, dual-side assignment and exact cross-catalog part aliasing are separate confidence dimensions and should not be collapsed into one verification flag.
recommended_pipeline_changes: Parse and retain SVG sodipodi:docname and inkscape:export-filename as structured provenance fields.
Compare embedded names against repository path identity and emit source_identity_conflict when they disagree materially.
Support source_label, canonical_subject, canonical_catalog_id and original_path as separate fields.
Add an explicit nonphysical/game-reference route before physical figure matching.
Keep generic design/calibration assets eligible for style and geometry supervision while suppressing physical identity promotion.
Represent landmark review as layered states: semantic/orientation reviewed, geometry partially/fully reviewed, catalog identity verified, exact part alias verified.
next_queue_recommendation: Proceed to the Skywalker crosswalk review queue, while applying the provenance-conflict rules above to future RioForce ingestion.
